metaData.originalTitle: 虾马之后又火一个！OpenHuman 用 20 分钟了解你的一切，存成卡帕西式知识库
metaData.title: After Shama and Sima, Another One Goes Viral! OpenHuman Gets to Know Everything About You in 20 Minutes and Stores It in a Karpathy-Style Knowledge Base
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: OpenHuman is a fully automatic personal knowledge base Agent that connects 118+ third-party services, automatically fetches data every 20 minutes, and compresses it into a Karpathy-style local knowledge base without requiring manual maintenance.
metaData.summary: This article introduces the open-source project OpenHuman, an Agent tool that requires no active training or configuration from users. Unlike 'Shama'-style Agents that require users to write Prompts and configure workflows, OpenHuman connects over 118 services including Gmail, GitHub, Slack, and Notion with a single authorization, automatically polling and fetching new data every 20 minutes. The fetched data is cleaned, compressed, and structured into a 'memory tree', ultimately stored as a local SQLite database and Markdown files compatible with Obsidian. Additionally, OpenHuman includes the TokenJuice compression mechanism, which reduces Token consumption by 80%, and a virtual avatar called Mascot that can participate in Google Meet meetings. The article argues that OpenHuman solves three major pain points: API key management, data fragmentation, and context bloat. Its core value lies in 'understanding you' rather than just 'being capable'.

mainPoints.point: OpenHuman enables fully automatic personal knowledge base construction without manual maintenance.
mainPoints.explanation: It connects 118+ third-party services, automatically fetches user data every 20 minutes, and compresses it into a structured 'memory tree', solving the pain point of needing to manually organize and update traditional knowledge bases.

mainPoints.point: The TokenJuice mechanism significantly reduces Token consumption and improves AI response efficiency.
mainPoints.explanation: Before data is fed into the LLM, operations such as converting HTML to Markdown, shortening URLs, and deduplication can reduce Token consumption by up to 80%, effectively lowering usage costs and latency.

mainPoints.point: OpenHuman's 'subconscious loop' mechanism enables continuous autonomous thinking capabilities.
mainPoints.explanation: Even without active user interaction, the Agent automatically loads to-do items, reads recent memories, and autonomously decides on the next action, achieving a shift from passive response to proactive service.

keyQuotes: OpenHuman doesn't need you to teach it. Just connect your Gmail, GitHub, Slack, Notion, calendar... 118 services with one click, and it automatically fetches new data every 20 minutes, compressing it into a Karpathy-style local knowledge base.
Who gets it? I'm already tired of raising shrimps and horses. Finally, one that doesn't need teaching!
Previous Agents focused all their efforts on 'being capable', but when it came to 'understanding you', they always fell a bit short.
